name: Mining Rush

features.name: Cluster pays
features.description: Five or more matching symbols win on a 7x7 grid.

features.name: Dynamite mines
features.description: Scatters in wins become mines that stay on the reels.

features.name: Mine levels
features.description: Mines level up after three wins.

review:
An underground 7x7 cluster game. In the base game, any win that includes a dynamite scatter turns it into a mine that stays for the rest of the round.

Mines collect a point for each win, and three points level them up, making more wins likely. Three or more scatters give up to 20 free spins. The mine levels give it an unusual sense of build-up. 96.56% RTP.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Provider doesn't publish a volatility rating
No confirmed official max win figure
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
